question.text: The AIF Manager shall be responsible for:

answer.text: Only the investment decisions of the fund
Every decision of the Category I/II AIF

explanation.text: The Logic: The Manager is responsible for every decision of the Category I/II AIF, as part of the general obligations and responsibilities listed for Category I and II AIFs. The Trap: Limiting the Manager's responsibility to investment decisions, regulatory filings, or investor communications understates the comprehensive accountability set in the regulations. Note: Source page 85 of Series XIX-A AIF (Category I and II) Distributors workbook.
